summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Anchor Placement - Client Placement app. All requested features working correctly: Homepage, 5-step onboarding, role-based routing, Provider Dashboard with preferences, Requestor Dashboard, and Admin Dashboard.
passed_tests: Homepage loads correctly with hero section, CTAs ('I Have Space to Share', 'I Need to Place a Client', 'See If I Qualify')
Onboarding flow - all 5 steps complete successfully
Step 1: Organization type selection with grouped categories
Step 2: Organization name and contact name input
Step 3: Email and phone contact information
Step 4: State selection dropdown
Step 5: Goal selection (List space, Find placement, Explore partnerships)
Role-based routing: AFL_PROVIDER routes to /provider-dashboard
Role-based routing: GROUP_HOME routes to /provider-dashboard
Role-based routing: HOSPITAL_DISCHARGE_PLANNER routes to /requestor-dashboard
Role-based routing: HOMELESS_SHELTER routes to /requestor-dashboard
Provider Dashboard loads with welcome message, user name displayed
Provider Dashboard shows 5 active placements with status badges (Available, Limited, Full)
Provider Dashboard shows 4 pending incoming requests
Provider Dashboard quick action cards (List New Space, My Placements, Incoming Requests)
Provider Preferences panel opens correctly
Provider Preferences shows all 6 MATCH_FLAGS checkboxes (SUPERVISION_REQUIRED, NO_SEX_OFFENDER, MEDICAL_SUPPORT_NEEDED, BEHAVIORAL_HEALTH_SUPPORT, VA_ELIGIBLE, IMMEDIATE_PLACEMENT)
Provider Preferences Save button functional
Requestor Dashboard loads with welcome message
Requestor Dashboard shows placement requests list with status badges
Requestor Dashboard quick action cards (New Placement Request, Browse Placements)
Admin Dashboard accessible at /admin
Admin Dashboard shows stats (4 Placement Requests, 5 Active Placements, 2 Pending Agencies, 0 Urgent Requests)
Admin Dashboard shows Pending Agencies, Active Placement Requests with risk flags, System Alerts
Navigation from onboarding outcome screen to dashboards works correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend features tested and working. Role-based routing correctly implemented using ORG_CAPABILITIES mapping. Provider types (AFL_PROVIDER, INDEPENDENT_HOME_PROVIDER, GROUP_HOME, TRANSITIONAL_HOUSING, RESPITE_PROVIDER) route to /provider-dashboard. Requestor types (HOMELESS_SHELTER, HOSPITAL_DISCHARGE_PLANNER, etc.) route to /requestor-dashboard. MATCH_FLAGS used in Provider Preferences panel for placement type checkboxes.
